title: ESP32-C3 memory map, linker script and startup code in the runner toolchain
description: Link bare-metal RV32 programs for the C3 address map (IRAM/DRAM), startup that disables the watchdogs, verify the instruction stream in the explorer matches objdump. Research spike: image format for loading as the second-stage image from ROM.
right_now_summary: Work is focused on linking RV32 code, adding startup logic, and checking the image format.
